name: Webflow
description: Webflow describes itself as "the agentic web platform for modern businesses" — a visual site builder combining full CSS/HTML design control, a built-in CMS, hosting, and AI-driven optimization tools.
best_for: Webflow positions itself for marketers who want to build without developer bottlenecks, designers wanting pixel-perfect visual control, developers who want to empower non-technical teams while retaining code-level control, and agencies/freelancers building client sites at scale.
features: Visual builder with full CSS/HTML control
AI-powered site building and content generation
Managed hosting with global CDN (99.99% uptime cited)
